record.question: Who is the writer of a book "I do what I do"?
record.explanation: Answer B: Raghuram G. Rajan. Raghuram G. Rajan wrote I Do What I Do. IIT Gandhinagar Library’s original 2017 acquisitions bulletin records that title under Rajan and identifies Harper Collins as publisher. The other listed people are not its author. Reference: https://library.iitgn.ac.in/documents/library_files/2017/10102017.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
